name: luismc-homelink
description: Sets up the network side of a product that has a website plus a server in the user's home (design G: tunnel for remote, direct LAN at home, gateway, control plane). `homelink-setup` interviews the owner about the product's home server and install types, then writes the product's HomeLink profile and a task list. Draft: the kit it targets (HOMELINKSPEC) is not built yet.
